title: Cloudonym plan file
description: A wizard plan saved with Save plan (D100): the POST /v1/wizard request body, plus environments when the plan has two or more. Generated from WizardRequest in /openapi.json. project_picks and services may each be empty or omitted, but not both (wizard.empty).

$schema.description: Optional. The URL of this JSON Schema, for editors. Ignored by the API and the web app.

project.description: The project context: the four values without purpose. Each service adds its purpose

env.description: Canonical: prod, stg, dev, sbx, qa, uat, test, perf, dr. Common aliases are accepted and normalised (prd, production, live -> prod; staging -> stg; development -> dev; sandbox -> sbx; quality -> qa; acceptance -> uat; testing, tst -> test; performance, load -> perf; disaster, recovery -> dr).

region.description: A region or a zone of the provider, by name or by code (asia-northeast3, asia-northeast3-a, ane3, ane3a), or global. Names carry the region code (ane3); a zone name is accepted and resolved to its region, so zonal resources are named like regional ones. Country values and region names of another provider are 400 context.value_unsupported with candidates in supported. The region table is in /llms.txt. The project region is a single region: a multi-region or dual-region location here is 400 context.location_unsupported; give it per pick in location instead.

project_id_suffix.description: Optional suffix appended to the project ID (platform-billing-prod-team1), so a predictable ID can still be unique. Same rules as a tier: 2-16 lowercase letters or digits, not a reserved word (400 wizard.invalid_project_id_suffix, wizard.project_id_suffix_reserved). It is never shortened; the item key stays project/-/project_id/-/-/-. Project IDs are unique across Google Cloud and cannot be reused; Cloudonym does not check whether an ID is free.

project_picks.description: Project-level resources (no purpose in the name): rules placed in the project, its global or regional scope, such as vpc, subnet and firewall. At most 40

services.description: At most 20 services. purpose is the service name and namespace; after cleaning it must be non-empty, unique and not project

rules_version.description: Optional pin to a rules revision (YYYY-MM-DD.N). If it differs from the current revision the API answers 409 instead of returning names that may differ. Not a string -> 400.

environments.description: Ignored by the API. A plan file saved from the wizard (Save plan, D100) is this request body plus this list when the plan has two or more environments; project.env is the first. The API names project.env only, so send one request per environment with project.env set to each value.

WizardPick.description: One resource line: a preset or a rule. The same (rule, tier, role) may appear once per service (wizard.duplicate_pick)

preset.description: A preset id: web, was, bastion, intweb, intwas, file, db, object, run, sa, secret, gke, wip, bq, ar, topic, sub, dlq, dlqsub, build, conn, repo, cron, runjob, redis, worker, raw, ingest, appdata, ip, ig, bs, hc, url, cert, thps, fwd, urlredir, thp, fwdredir, neg, bb, vpc, subnet, firewall, router, nat, psa. null or omitted for a custom pick by rule. The presets are listed in /llms.txt Wizard presets

rule.description: A rule id (gcp.run_service) when preset is null. gcp.project_id is always included and cannot be picked (wizard.reserved_pick)

tier.description: The tier token placed after the abbreviation and kind token, before the sequence (billing-shop-prod-ane3-gce-web-01). On rules with a sequence number, and on Google Cloud rules with neither a sequence number nor a role, where it goes right after the abbreviation (platform-billing-shop-prod-ane3-gcs-uploads); never on role rules. Overrides the preset tier. Abbreviations, kind tokens, environment values and region codes are reserved (wizard.tier_reserved)

role.description: Only on role rules, as on /names

kind.description: A kind value name, as on /names

ha.description: High availability: only on the web and was presets as virtual machines; needs at least 2 servers (wizard.count_below_min)

serverless.description: Run the web or was preset on a serverless rule instead of a virtual machine: gcp.cloud_function or gcp.run_service

location.description: A multi-region or dual-region location for this pick, by name or code (US, us, ASIA1). Only on rules that take one: storage_bucket (US, EU, ASIA, ASIA1, EUR4, EUR5, EUR7, EUR8, NAM4) and bigquery_dataset (US, EU). The name carries its code in the region slot (…-prod-us-gcs). Omitted: the project region. On secret picks the only value is regional (D79): omitted, the secret is global and its name has no region token; regional puts the project region in its name (…-prod-ane3-secret-01), and is 400 wizard.location_needs_region when the project region is global. Anything else is 400 wizard.invalid_location with the accepted locations in params.supported.

instances.description: One slot per server (rules with a sequence number only). Required on those rules

id.description: Slot id, unique within the pick (used by share links)

seq.description: The sequence number in the name, unique within the pick

attach.description: Attached resources (virtual machines only): boot disk, data disks, static external (ip) and internal (ipi) address
